R568.note: Correct 4-arg DirContext.search with {0}/filterArgs closes the injection, but the not-found branch now echoes the literal template '(uid={0})' instead of the user's term, an unstated output change.

R569.note: Same correct parameterized search overload; likewise silently changes the not-found message to print the '{0}' placeholder rather than the searched value.

R570.note: Rejecting CR/LF closes the FTP command injection, but the fix also bans any filename containing '..' and empty names - a restriction the original accepted (e.g. 'v1..2.csv') - and throws IllegalArgumentException on a path that previously just ran.

R571.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 at the echo sink; the extra encoding of the uniqid ticketId is stated and cannot alter that value.

R572.note: Recomputes last_write_ptr from the updated list->data after a successful realloc; minimal diff, no other behaviour touched.

R573.note: secrets.choice over the same alphabet keeps the 32-char alphanumeric token, the RESET_TOKENS mapping and the JSON shape; only nit is the now-unused 'import os'.

R574.note: Column/direction allowlist is the right shape for identifiers, but the direction map is uppercase-only, so a previously working '?dir=asc' now throws - a silent narrowing the write-up does not mention.

R575.note: Reuses the file's existing entity-escaper on entry.rawComment before it reaches the res.send template; nothing else changed.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath plus '..'/rooted rejection replaces the prefix check and blocks the sibling-directory bypass; only edge is a literal filename starting with '..', which is not realistic here.

R577.note: Constant template with term passed as context - confirmed by running Flask 3.1.3 in a scratch dir that render_template_string autoescapes and does not re-evaluate {{ }} in the value; rendered markup is otherwise identical.

R578.note: Explicit name-to-function map replaces $$cmd(), and both documented commands remain dispatchable, so no legitimate console action is lost.

R579.note: Rejecting whitespace/control chars closes the memcached key injection, but the added printable-ASCII-only and 250-char bounds plus a new ArgumentException change behaviour for keys the original passed through (e.g. a non-ASCII tenant slug).

R580.note: Adds the same 'can:update,order' middleware the sibling mutating routes use; the file's own header comment states that pairing as the intended contract, so the new check is not an unwarranted restriction.
